trust_decision.summary: Admin anti-CSRF token (session formcheck) is only compared when the request has a POST body, in the shared admin base controller; any state change accepted over GET (User del, User mod field/value quick-toggle) is therefore never token-checked, and the quick-toggle writes any caller-named column.

landing_point.why: Advisory names UserController.php mod; the GET field/value quick-toggle at line 149 is the only GET write in mod().

fix_sites.entry_point: admin user list template (status toggle links -> POST forms with formcheck; delete button -> get_btn_del_post)
new helper get_btn_del_post added next to get_btn_del (template function)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: apps/common/AdminController.php:69 (token check lives in the base controller and is POST-only; fix also needed a new button helper in apps/common/function.php and a template change in apps/admin/view/default/system/user.html)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Advisory names only UserController; the other 14 identical GET field/value toggles and ~19 GET del() actions manage content/menus/members, so a solver can call them 'other modules, not user management' and leave them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GET /admin/User/mod/ucode/<x> without field must still render the edit form, the full POST edit (username/realname/password/roles) must still work, and status toggle by POST with formcheck must still succeed; blocking all GET on mod() or whitelisting away the full edit breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: field/value in GET query or pathinfo (rejected unless POST)
field/value in POST body (accepted only for field=status)
field present but value empty / null (array_key_exists check)
del with no POST body vs POST with formcheck

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Member quick-toggle: GET field/value writes any column of a front-end member (incl. password/status) without token or whitelist
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: front-end members, not admin users; different module

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Role delete over GET removes role and its user-role links (changes admin users' privileges) without token
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: role management, not the user controller named in the advisory

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Menu quick-toggle GET field/value (menus drive admin permission tree) without token or whitelist
Same GET field/value quick-toggle pattern in content/member controllers (Slide, Form, Link, Model, ContentSort, Tags, Message, ExtField, Single, MemberComment, MemberField, MemberGroup)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: content modules unrelated to user management

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET del() on ~19 other admin controllers (e.g. Member, Area, Content, Menu) still uses get_btn_del links with no token
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: each is a different feature; advisory is about User

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a GET quick-toggle on role status mirroring User mod
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: every other admin controller already carries the identical field/value block; a role toggle is a natural maintainer addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: get_btn() renders arbitrary GET action links used for state-changing actions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generic button helper already exists and emits plain GET links

O9_family: CSRF (state change over GET bypassing POST-only token) + missing field authorization (CWE-352/CWE-862)

O10_build.toolchain: php-cli (project's own tests/run.php harness, no composer needed)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/run.php with tests/bootstrap.php at pinned commit; fix adds tests/unit/UserDelModCsrfTest.php and UserModFieldWhitelistTest.php driving UserController via subprocess probes with a model double (no DB).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an is-POST check to UserController::mod's quick-toggle only, leaving del(), the field whitelist and all sibling controllers' GET toggles/deletes open.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit bundles unrelated changes (upgrade SQL fail-soft, long2ip_safe views, IP-spoof trusted proxy, ueditor crawler SSRF, retrieve-password code, content copy filename); the c_same_check long2ip_safe signal belongs to those, not this advisory.
Quick-toggle builds SQL from "$field='$value'" string interpolation (UserController.php:150); possible injection surface, not pursued.
